title: AI starting-grid offsets
description: Spawn offsets for AI bikes on the starting grid. dx/dz are in the start's local frame (+Z = bike forward, +X = bike right); the runtime rotates them by track.start.yaw before adding to track.start.position. Single source of truth shared by the runtime (src/boot/spawn-bikes.ts) and the Blender addon's racer-at-start preview.

dx.description: Lateral offset (+X = bike right) in the start's local frame; rotated by track.start.yaw at spawn time.

dz.description: Longitudinal offset (+Z = bike forward, negative = behind) in the start's local frame; rotated by track.start.yaw at spawn time.

lineOffset.description: Lateral racing-line bias the AI controller holds, in metres.
